notes.title: Sequel Announcement & more
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Even though The Suicide of Rachel Foster has already been around for a few years, 
we've still got some exciting news for you!

[h3][b]TSORF Definitive Edition for PS5[/b][/h3]

We bring to you an improved version of The Suicide of Rachel Foster for PlayStation5.

The Definitive Edition comes with
[list]
[*] A free upgrade for PS4 edition owners
[*] Upscaled textures in 60 fps and Dolby Atmos support
[*] New adaptive triggers for perfect immersion
[*] Haptic feedback & dynamic vibrations
[*] An additionally available artbook
[/list]
But the news don't end here...

[h3][b]The Fading of Nicole Wilson[/b][/h3]

Years ago, Nicole Wilson found out about the tragic fate of Rachel. But what happened to Nicole?

[b]Now Nicole's story continues.[/b]

We are very excited to let you know that you can now 
[b]wishlist the upcoming sequel "The Fading of Nicole Wilson"[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2947700/The_Fading_of_Nicole_Wilson/

We are celebrating these news with a thrilling 90% discount on The Suicide of Rachel Foster,
so everybody can refresh their and Nicole's memory or experience the story for the first,
spinechilling time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057750/The_Suicide_of_Rachel_Foster/

We hope you share our excitement about us working on this new title.

Until next time,
One-O-One Games and Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: New Language and Polishing Patch
notes.content:
Heyho everyone,

You might be wondering - Why is there a ~7gb patch for The Suicide of Rachel Foster? Don't worry, we just can't get enough of it! For any Japanese, Korean, or Polish players who haven't had the chance to play yet due to the language, the barriers have been lifted!

Additionally to adding those 3 languages, we did some general polishing and stabilisation.

Best Regards!

notes.title: Patch 1.03D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36295028/b35be8add1f31a50bf0ea03eb6e2d6fafdd09846.png[/img]

Today we released the first patch for our game. In this update, we corrected a lot of known issues especially with the Chinese localization. We thank you all for your support! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: We are live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36295028/0f2c03e9f1e04380d1547e8a88737f715d971a28.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Suicide of Rachel Foster is out now![/h3]

Find yourselves trapped in an isolated mountain hotel and uncover what truly happened to Rachel Foster, a young woman who seemingly took her own life 10 years ago.

You will follow Nicole, a young woman driven by her mother’s dying wish to uncover her family's dark past. She finds herself in the dilapidated and abandoned family hotel on a snow filled mountain. Knowing her own father had a role to play in the downfall of Rachel, Nicole relies on the support of a young FEMA agent to unearth the truth once and for all.
